:::: eg-contact-form-grid

::: eg-contact-form-card

<!-- The form is sent in the background (see script below), so visitors stay on
     this page and see the thank-you message here instead of on Formspree. -->
<form id="eg-contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/mzedganj" method="POST">

<div class="eg-form-row">
<label for="name" class="form-label">Name</label>
<input type="text" class="custom-input" id="name" name="name" required>
</div>

<div class="eg-form-row">
<label for="email" class="form-label">Email</label>
<input type="email" class="custom-input" id="email" name="email" required>
</div>

<div class="eg-form-row">
<label for="organization" class="form-label">Organization <span class="eg-form-hint">(optional)</span></label>
<input type="text" class="custom-input" id="organization" name="organization">
</div>

<div class="eg-form-row">
<label for="message" class="form-label">Tell us about your landscape</label>
<textarea class="custom-input" id="message" name="message" rows="5" required></textarea>
</div>

<!-- Anti-spam: keeps the subject line clean and silently drops bot submissions -->
<input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New inquiry — ArdhiLytics website">
<input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">

<!-- Spam check: Cloudflare Turnstile. The secret key lives in Formspree
     (form Settings > CAPTCHA); only the public site key goes here. -->
<div class="eg-form-row eg-turnstile cf-turnstile" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAAFxBeg6UH6W4_t_P" data-theme="light" data-size="flexible"></div>

<button type="submit" class="eg-btn eg-btn-solid">Send us a brief</button>

<div id="eg-form-status" class="eg-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

</form>

<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js" async defer></script>

<!-- Sends the form to Formspree in the background and shows the result on this page.
     If JavaScript is off, the form still works the old way (via Formspree's page). -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var form = document.getElementById("eg-contact-form");
  var status = document.getElementById("eg-form-status");
  if (!form || !status || !window.fetch) return;
  var button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
  var buttonText = button.textContent;

  function show(kind, html) {
    status.className = "eg-form-status is-visible is-" + kind;
    status.innerHTML = html;
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    // wait for the Turnstile spam check to finish before sending
    var token = form.querySelector('[name="cf-turnstile-response"]');
    if (!token || !token.value) {
      show("error", "<strong>Almost there.</strong> Please wait for the security check " +
        "above the button to finish, then click send again.");
      return;
    }

    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = "Sending…";
    status.className = "eg-form-status";

    fetch(form.action, {
      method: "POST",
      body: new FormData(form),
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
    }).then(function (response) {
      if (response.ok) {
        form.reset();
        show("success",
          "<strong>Thank you — your brief is on its way.</strong> " +
          "We'll be in touch at the email address you provided.");
      } else {
        return response.json().then(function (data) {
          var msg = (data && data.errors)
            ? data.errors.map(function (er) { return er.message; }).join(", ")
            : "Something went wrong.";
          show("error", "<strong>Sorry, your message didn't send.</strong> " + msg +
            " Please try again, or email us at <a href='mailto:info@ardhilytics.com'>info@ardhilytics.com</a>.");
        });
      }
    }).catch(function () {
      show("error", "<strong>Sorry, your message didn't send.</strong> " +
        "Please check your connection and try again, or email us at " +
        "<a href='mailto:info@ardhilytics.com'>info@ardhilytics.com</a>.");
    }).finally(function () {
      // each security token works once, so get a fresh one for the next message
      if (window.turnstile) { window.turnstile.reset(); }
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = buttonText;
    });
  });
});
</script>

:::
